messages:
dana: Heads-up: small canary showed inflated token usage after we enabled route aliasing. suspect: resume id change on aliasing causing duplicate provisional writes.
priyam: example trace?
dana: https://console.redwood.internal/trace/zz-987. stream s-9 shows provisional(30) then confirmed(32) but both stayed.
lucy: billing GC is supposed to expire provisional after 1h. maybe the confirmed uses a different idempotency key so GC can't reconcile.
zack: router currently generates resume_id = hash(route_meta || resume_index). alias rewrite changes route_meta, so resume_id flips. bad.
priyam: immediate mitigation: billing can normalize id by using canonical_stream_id if present, else fallback to resume_id. we already attach canonical_stream_id at ingress for v2 streams.
lucy: I can add a short-term billing rule: if provisional and confirmed share same session+toolcall within 10s, mark provisional reconciled. will deploy as hotfix.
dana: also add UI toggle to hide provisional in quota view while we fix. support is getting tickets.
zack: long-term: change router to keep canonical_stream_id stable across alias rewrites instead of embedding route_meta. safer to use that for idempotency.
priyam: ok owners: @lucy on billing hotfix + reconciliation lambda, @zack on router invariant RFC, @dana to add console flag. ops-bot create incident please.
ops-bot: incident-created: INC-2024-621 -> duplicate-provisional-on-route-alias (owners: @lucy @zack @dana)
dana: thanks, will schedule postmortem after fix and update rollout checklist to block alias toggles when provisional ratio > 0.05.
